You jump into a hole straight through the Earth. How long until you pop out the other side?
Guess: four minutes, forty minutes, or four hours? Comment one, two or three.

text: Ignore the heat: the core is about as hot as the Sun's surface.
In the middle, you're going over eight kilometers per second!

Then gravity starts pulling you back, and you slow down.

text: You pop out on the other side after about thirty-eight minutes. Answer two!

The old textbook answer was forty-two. But Earth's heavy core pulls you faster.

text: And with no air to stop you, you fall back. Again and again. Forever.
Would you take the jump? Yes or no?
